group_note: Groups overlap and are not additive. Subtest count is retained from the runner; it is not a count of independent task problems.
privacy: Only case identity/outcome fields are projected from JUnit. Hostname, local paths, stdout/stderr, credentials and contributor session identities are omitted.
scope: Maintainer-run offline controls; synthetic telemetry in Docker/Harbor integration tests; no live model trials or independent replication.
